A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. The main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–H support reliable comparison despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v2 reports original simulations on the Hard MDP family in Section 5 and baseline comparisons and larger synthetic MDP experiments in Appendix H.

after.justification: v3 retains these original simulations, including Figure 2 and the experimental comparisons in Appendix H, Tables 2–3.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–3 retain the same empirical transition estimation, DR Bellman solves, discount calibration, and anchoring procedure. The iteration added in Appendix A.7 serves the new existence proof.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the two-state, two-action Hard MDP family under KL and chi-squared uncertainty, plus 20-state, 30-action synthetic MDPs under KL uncertainty in Appendix H.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains DR RVI Q-learning from Wang et al. (2023e) alongside Reduction to DMDP and Anchored DR-AMDP. The newly cited Wang and Si (2025) work is not an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: The sampling procedures, l-infinity estimation-error metric, value-iteration ground truth, and experimental settings are retained. Appendix H keeps the sample-size series from 10 to 100000 and uncertainty radii of 0.1 and 0.4 in the corresponding experiments.

E4.justification: Figure 2 retains the same convergence analyses across transition parameters and divergence choices. Appendix H retains the larger-MDP stress experiment with radius 0.4 violating Assumption 2; no additional ablation or robustness analysis appears.

E5.justification: Section 5 still reports one independent run per plotted point and fitted regression lines. The new checklist calls those existing fits statistical-significance reporting but adds no repeated-run information, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 2–3 and all seven embedded result plots are unchanged. For example, at 100000 samples, Table 2 retains errors of 2.61e-2 for DR RVI Q-learning, 1.17e-3 for Reduction to DMDP, and 1.23e-3 for Anchored DR-AMDP.

T1.justification: Proposition 3.6 adds an explicit uniformly bounded minorization-time requirement and asserts Bellman-solution existence, supported by the new proof in Proposition A.7. Equation (F.14) also corrects 1/(k^k) to 1/(k^*), matching its proof. The main sample-complexity guarantees remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same two algorithms, first finite-sample guarantee claim, near-optimal sample-complexity claims, and scope under uniform ergodicity and sufficiently small KL or f_k uncertainty sets.

C2.justification: The new checklist characterizes the existing regression fits as evidence of statistical significance without providing a corresponding test. The convergence interpretations, Appendix H discussion of violating Assumption 2, and Section 6 limitations otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Checklist item 5 newly states that complete experimental code is included in supplemental materials; v2 contains no such availability statement. This is an added disclosure, although the code and its accessibility cannot be verified from the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Wang and Si (2025), discussing Bellman-solution existence for s-rectangular robust average-reward MDPs under one-sided weak communication. The remaining cited works and overall novelty positioning are retained.

P1.justification: Most prose and the scientific section order are retained. v3 inserts a NeurIPS checklist before the appendices, switches to numbered citations, updates author affiliations and corresponding-author information, and makes localized wording edits.

P2.justification: v3 reformats the document throughout into the NeurIPS template, changing the title and author block, typography, text width, caption styling, and figure sizing and placement. Table 1 moves before Section 2, Algorithm 3 follows Theorem 4.5, and the Appendix H plots are consolidated on the final page.

improvement.justification: The revised Proposition 3.6, supporting existence argument in Appendix A.7, and correction to Equation (F.14) modestly improve theoretical completeness and consistency. The algorithms and empirical evidence remain unchanged. These gains are tempered by the new checklist's unsupported characterization of regression fits as statistical significance.
